newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia tenders to sell off tourism firm.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia tenders to sell off tourism firm.

text.p: Tunisia has launched an international tender to sell tourism firm Societe de Transport Touristique (TRANSTOURS) as part of its privatisation programme, officials said on Tuesday.
They said the tender was for the sale of TRANSTOURS's entire 234,000 shares.
The firm manages three hotels, two of which it owns, and four travel agencies. It also organises tours and has a bus rental department with 45 vehicles.

It has a capital of 1.17 million dinars and its main shareholders are state-controlled Societe Nationale de Transports (SNT) with 77.2 percent, and Banque de Developpement Economique de la Tunisie with 10.8 percent.
Last results of the company show its turnover in 1996 was estimated at 4.171 million dinars and net profits at 95,000 dinars.
